personality_one_liner: A high-efficiency, visually crisp B2B management tool where the product catalog takes center stage and the chrome stays out of the way.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Form labels above inputs. Lists and cards padded comfortably. Always sticky primary CTA at bottom with safe-area clearance.

do's: Floating action buttons (FAB) over brandTertiary tint
Sticky headers when scrolling long product catalogs

screens.name: Auth Flow (Signup/Login/PIN/Handle)
screens.purpose: Securely onboard the wholesale seller, capture their unique shop handle, and set up a PIN for daily rapid entry.

states.error: Readable inline error message below the specific input field in onError color, plus a Toast.

screens.layout: Clean, single-column forms. Large typography for step titles. Inputs have labels above them. The primary 'Next' or 'Submit' CTA is sticky at the bottom of the screen (KeyboardAvoidingView) with safe-area padding. PIN setup uses an iOS-style borderless number pad centered on screen.

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: Provide a high-level overview of wholesale operations and quick actions for store management.

states.empty: Illustration of a shop with 'Welcome to your wholesale store' and a primary CTA to 'Add your first product'.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll. Top section: Quick stat cards (Pending Orders, Low Stock) using a 2-column flex-wrap grid with space-between. Middle section: Horizontal scrolling row of Action Shortcuts (Customize Store, Manage Groups, Add Product). Bottom section: Recent Alerts or 3 most recent orders.

screens.name: Product Catalog & Groups
screens.purpose: Manage the B2B inventory, update MOQs, and organize products into catalogs.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of a box with 'Your catalog is empty'. Primary CTA to 'Add Product'.
states.error: Toast message indicating sync failure, retry button.

screens.layout: Header contains a Search bar and segmented control (All Products / By Group). List view: Rows with square image (left), Title/Price/MOQ (center), and Status Badge (right). A prominent floating action button (FAB) in the bottom right for 'Add Product' with glass effect.

screens.name: Product Form (Create/Edit)
screens.purpose: Capture comprehensive wholesale product details including multiple images, descriptions, pricing, and MOQ.

states.loading: Spinner during image upload or saving.
states.error: Red text below invalid fields (e.g., missing price) and sticky error banner if upload fails.

screens.layout: Scrollable form. Top: Horizontal scroll view for multi-image upload with a prominent 'Add Image' tile. Below: Single column inputs (Title, Price, MOQ, Stock Status toggle, Group selector). A sticky 'Save Product' CTA anchored at the bottom over a glassmorphic background.

screens.name: Orders Inbox
screens.purpose: Process incoming B2B orders efficiently across different fulfillment stages.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of a clipboard: 'No orders here yet'.
states.error: Error text with a retry button centered.

screens.layout: Sticky top tab bar (Pending | Accepted | Shipped). Vertical list of order cards. Cards display Buyer Name (bold), Order ID, total amount, item count, and a right-aligned CTA (e.g., 'Accept Order' or 'Mark Shipped'). Cards fill 100% width minus screen padding (lg).

screens.name: Storefront Customization & Preview
screens.purpose: Allow the seller to brand their buyer-facing B2B storefront and preview the public web layout.
screens.layout: Top half: Inputs for Store Title, Banner Image upload, and Brand Color picker (grid of predefined hex circles or input). Bottom half (or a full-screen Modal): A 'Live Preview' area wrapped in a mock mobile browser frame showing exactly how the buyer sees the catalog.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for iOS-Native Clean (Personality 1). Maintain generous padding, avoid clutter, and use a crisp light-theme palette featuring the terracotta accent.
Ensure all primary call-to-actions (e.g., 'Save Product', 'Next', 'Add to Cart') are sticky at the bottom of scrolling views with correct safe-area clearances to avoid the home indicator.
Images overlaid with text (e.g. the Buyer Preview Store Banner) MUST include a vertical top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (0% transparent to 70%+ surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG AA contrast.
For the multi-image upload component, use a horizontally scrolling list of square thumbnails. The first tile should be a 'brandTertiary' tinted button to add a new image.
Order Management and Product Catalog rows must have a minimum 56pt touch target height.
Never use indigo, blue, purple, or generic emoji. Rely on Ionicons (outline or filled consistently per screen).
When displaying the Buyer-side preview, visually wrap the preview in a lightweight 'device frame' or modal sheet to distinguish it from the seller's operational UI.
Haptics must be wired into all primary interactions: product saves, tab switches, and order status updates.
